name: app-lime-black-bike-rental-ui-elements-board
title: Lime and Black Bike Rental UI Elements
whatItIs: A tall board with a header row of bicycle cards and nav pills on black, a heading 'UI Elements', a tilted phone detail with stat circles and Book Now, and a lime panel with a hand holding the phone plus a blurred cyclist photo.
whatItMeans: Neon lime on near-black is sporty and sustainable, and mixing tight component crops with lifestyle photos tells both the design and the story.
techniques: Lime cards as bold accents among dark cards
Circular stat icons in pastel lime, lilac and grey
Extreme crop of the phone at an angle
Light and dark versions of the same card side by side
bestFor: UI element showcases in case studies

vocabulary.definition: A layout showing individual UI elements outside the full screens.
A round icon with a number showing one metric.
Streaking that implies movement in a photo.
